name: Tuna-Gnocchi Sauté with Zucchini, Tomato, Fresh Mozzarella & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add salt and gnocchi; cook, stirring frequently, until cooked through, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
3 (454 g) pkgs potato gnocchi

instructions.primary_message: While the gnocchi are cooking, trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, capers, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini and onion soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp capers
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain tuna, place in the reserved bowl, and flake with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes and add to the bowl with the tuna.

When the veggies are soft, juice lemons into the pot. Add cooked gnocchi, tuna, and tomatoes, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.

instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add mozzarella and basil to the pot with the gnocchi, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide tuna-gnocchi sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
